scopeHint: Only explicitly selected documents can change. Search and pagination keep your selection.
unsupported: This value is preserved. Use Advanced JSON to edit nested or mixed values.
emptyValues: No metadata values. Add a field to describe this document.
invalid: Check the field name, type and value before continuing.
operationHint: Scalars are set directly. Lists append and deduplicate values; an empty list does not clear an existing list. Choose Delete entire field to remove it.
filterHint: The condition is intersected with your selection. It can only reduce the document range.
previewCount: {{matched}} documents match; {{changed}} would change. {{excluded}} selected documents are excluded by the condition.
deleteWarning: This removes metadata from the documents shown below. Review the before and after values before confirming.
noMatches: No selected documents match. No changes were sent.
noChanges: The selected operation makes no changes. No changes were sent.
changedSincePreview: Metadata changed since review. Review the latest values before applying again.
unverified: {{count}} documents could not be confirmed. Keep your draft and review again; a write may already have succeeded.
partial: The server matched {{matched}} documents and reported {{updated}} changes. Check the readback results below.
notLoaded: Documents could not be loaded. Retry before selecting or applying changes.
renameHint: Rename {{from}} to {{to}} across this dataset. Current usage: {{count}}.
deleteTagHint: Remove tag {{name}} across this dataset. Current usage: {{count}}.
saveVerified: Settings saved and confirmed by readback.
sourceError: Tag sources could not be loaded. Retry to see available sources.
reloadWarning: Reloading replaces the current draft with stored settings.
clearTemplate: An empty template explicitly removes custom extraction fields when saved. Existing document values are preserved.
configIncomplete: Metadata configuration is incomplete. Reload before saving to preserve the existing template.
tagReadbackIncomplete: Tag readback reached the 1000-item aggregation limit. The change may have succeeded, but this list cannot confirm that all old tag associations were removed. Retry readback or use a complete tag check.
baselineFilterLimit: Batch conditions support unambiguous text, YYYY-MM-DD dates and positive text-list conditions. Text that may be interpreted as Python literals cannot be used in scalar comparisons. Exclusion conditions, numeric, boolean, mixed-value and empty-value filters are unavailable here; select documents directly to update those values.
configConflict: The stored template changed while you were editing. Your draft is preserved; reload and review before saving.
noListItems: This list template allows no items. Its constraint is preserved; use Advanced JSON to change the schema explicitly.
baselineTypeOnly: This change only replaces false/0 or true/1 types, which the current batch service treats as unchanged. No write was sent; adjust the operation and review again.
tagAggregationScopeHint: Select libraries from the accessible pages below. Queries use only the selected IDs; there is no automatic all-library scope.
tagAggregationOwnerChanged: Your account or credentials changed. Reload the sources and select libraries again.
tagAggregationInvalidScope: Select at least one valid library ID.
tagAggregationInvalidResponse: The tag service returned invalid counts or duplicate tags.
tagAggregationNoSources: No accessible libraries on this page.
tagAggregationPageHint: Page {{page}}: {{count}} libraries returned. This page is not a complete library inventory.
tagAggregationFailed: The selected scope could not be fully read. No distribution is shown; retry the selected scope.
tagAggregationIncomplete: Returned tag counts are not a complete tag inventory.
tagAggregationDistributionHint: The service reads at most 1000 tag buckets per tenant group and provides no completeness flag. Per-library reads are separate observations and may differ from the combined count if truncated or changed during loading. “Not returned” does not mean zero. Counts are reported tag usage, not unique-document totals.
tagAggregationCapped: A response reached 1000 tag buckets. Additional tags may be omitted; this limit cannot be resolved by paging.
tagAggregationNoSearch: No returned tags match this search.
tagAggregationEmpty: No tags returned for the selected scope. This is not proof that all selected libraries have no tags.
